oferta.headline: See the launch in the golden window — before saturation.
oferta.subtitle: Radar Global monitors public signals of digital products and shows what is being born, what is already live, and whether the niche is crowded.

oferta.what2Body: Hot, moderate or saturated. Pick offers with data, not gut feel.
oferta.what3Body: When a signal is verified, you get domain, evidence and contact to affiliate.

oferta.guaranteeBody: 7 days to try it. No income claims. Market-intelligence software.
